{{Quote|Crix Madine, for one, founded and trained the Emperor's Storm Commandos and was part of the operation that released the Candorian Plague on Dentaal—a shocking act of genocide.|[[Gial Ackbar/Legends|Gial Ackbar]]|<ref name="The Essential Guide to Warfare">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref>}}
The '''Dentaal Uprising''' occurred on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dentaal/Legends|Dentaal]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] when the [[Dentaal Independence Party]] overthrew [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Governor/Legends|Governor]] [[Taliff]]. The Empire responded by deploying the [[Candorian plague/Legends|Candorian plague]] to the planet and killing the world's entire population.
